_comment: Thin pointer. Copy this ENTIRE hooks block into C:/Users/EQ/.claude/settings.json (USER scope) -- root-scope-only wiring (C:/Projects/.claude/settings.json) silently doesn't fire for a session launched inside a repo or worktree, which is the common case. That gap hit SessionStart (fixed 2026-07-12) and then pre_tool_use.py's F9 check (fixed 2026-08-05, system/failures.md -> F9 recurrence 4) before this template was corrected to match. The LOGIC lives in the governed, versioned repo (eq-context/hooks/); nothing here but wiring -- see Phase 4: facts live in one place. Forward slashes only, everywhere in this file including comments -- backslash Windows paths get silently mangled by this harness's hook-command parsing (found + fixed 2026-07-27, sessions/2026-07-27.md) and can produce invalid JSON if hand-edited carelessly (found 2026-08-05). auto_pr_guard.py is a real, built rung-4 guard (hooks/README.md) but intentionally NOT wired below yet -- it's inert without EQ_AUTO_PR_MODE=1 and has no scheduled/automated run to protect; wire it here when that changes.
